statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated
The service is for extended ambulatory assessment
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and optimize rate control management
Diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0 support the service
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The submitted materials do not align with records maintained in the insurer's system
